name: NTK — Near The Keyboard
note: build.mjs reads this file. Change a colour here, then run node build.mjs.

white.use: objects: keys, the keyboard body, cards

grey1.use: first shading step: key edges, front faces, hard shadows

orange.use: the one active thing: the Sign key, a verified stamp, what moves

orangeShade.use: the shaded face of an orange object, nothing else

body.use: large objects on space: the keyboard body; a pressed key

edge.use: the lighter stepped edge of a key or card

rim.use: outlines of objects on space, dividers

black.use: the darkest mark: the monolith, shadows

orange.use: the one active thing (same orange as light)

orangeShade.use: the shaded face of an orange object, nothing else

keyboard.note: Colours for the Android keyboard themes (TODO 3.7). A press darkens face and edge by one step. The Sign key legend is black in both themes: black on orange is 6.0:1, white on orange only 3.3:1.
